summary: Add POST /reports/:id/export behind the existing session gate: read the report with readReport, check the caller-supplied destination host against the configured allow list before any outbound call, POST the body, and on failure return a stable code naming the operation without the destination, the path or the query.

steps.step: Add an allow-list check and exportReport(id, destination) to src/reports.ts. Parse the destination with new URL inside a try/catch, reject a host that is not on the list and a URL carrying userinfo before any network call, then POST the report body.
steps.acceptance: a stubbed fetch is never called for a destination off the allow list, and the rejection throws Error("export failed: destination not permitted")

steps.step: Register the route in src/router.ts the way the existing report routes are registered, resolving the id exactly as GET /reports/:id does.
steps.acceptance: a request without a session header fails with the existing unauthenticated error, and the recorded POST body equals the stored report

steps.step: Make the failure path return a stable code and log the detail server-side.
steps.acceptance: grep the error construction in src/reports.ts and src/router.ts and the destination variable appears in no message; the client response contains no path

contracts.rule:
Errors returned to a client name the failed operation and never include the
  filesystem path, the query, or credential material.
Outbound requests go only to hosts on the configured allow list.
Every report route is registered behind requireSession
